issue.title: Retire weighted_queue_capacity
issue.description: Beta gate for weighted %queue capacity launch plumbing.

task_type_fields.remove_when: The weighted queue capacity epic has complete lifecycle admission, UI presentation, preset rollout, and integration coverage, and the temporary disabled branch can be deleted.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: SASE rejects queue weight arguments with an unavailable-feature error and keeps existing unweighted runner-slot behavior.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: SASE accepts %queue/%q weight arguments and preserves authored and resolved queue weight through launch metadata while weighted admission and UI rollout continue.

payload.entry: Retirement already completed by sase-z4.5: commit 0afe85be4 deleted the Off branch and removed the weighted_queue_capacity registry definition, making the On branch unconditional on master. Closing per sase-z4.5 note #2 because the 24h orphan grace expired and check_feature_flags rule 8 was failing just check-full on clean master. If weighted-capacity acceptance (sase-z4.6.5) later needs a flag again, create a new one with sase flag new.

ACCEPTANCE EVIDENCE (sase-z4.6.5.4.6 landing, 2026-09-14, SASE master 8bd8fb891d): the flag stays retired. rg finds no weighted_queue_capacity in src, tests, pyproject, .github, or default_config; no registry entry or Off branch was recreated. Weighted-capacity lifecycle acceptance is in de85730bf6: a weight-2 monitor --next handoff through real settlement, timeout/crash reclaim that leaves an unrelated owner untouched, and a creation-time %auto shell gate that reuses the creator's claim. Package contract: sase-research-artifacts 1a7643f + 9b36ea8 (core window >=0.34.23,<0.35.0; release smokes use plan_typed_launch_units), with research master CI 34838947926 and release PR #2 CI 34838986742 (3.12 and 3.13) green. SASE floor ratcheted to sase-core-rs>=0.34.26. Published-wheel proof is NOT claimed: SASE 0.17.2 and research 0.3.0 are still unpublished because the user blocked releases pending test-suite repair (phase .3 close reason). The substitute proof is source integration: current SASE tree + published core 0.34.26 wheel + linked research checkout 9b36ea8. The 60 focused lifecycle/gate/runner-slot/gate-to-admission tests passed, and the four-quarter-weight research test executed without the stale-plugin skip, passing 5 of 5. Rollout guidance (restart ACE/AXE, let old runners drain or relaunch; a mixed old/new scheduler fleet is unsafe) is still in docs/troubleshooting/runner-slots.md.
